Adventure.label: Adventure
Adventure.description: Snappy dreamed of treasure maps and faraway shores as a fledgling. Whip-cracking archaeologists, pirates, explorers and gentlemen racing around the globe against the clock became its travel companions.

AnimatedComedy.label: Animated Comedy
AnimatedComedy.description: Snappy stays up for grown-up cartoons long after the little ones are in bed. Mad scientists, delivery crews of the far future, a yellow family and space refugees hiding in the suburbs kept it laughing until sunrise.

Anime.label: Anime
Anime.description: Snappy discovered anime late one night and has not been to bed on time since. Samurai cats who run a pizzeria, sweet-toothed geniuses and a boy in a straw hat set these costumes in motion.

Cartoons.label: Cartoons
Cartoons.description: Snappy laughed its feathers off at cartoon slapstick. Cats chasing mice, coyotes strapped to rockets, lasagna-loving house cats and a slinky pink cat on tiptoe still make it giggle.

Christmas.label: Christmas
Christmas.description: Snappy has always been the first to put up the tree. Santa suits, glowing reindeer noses, gingerbread and one very green fellow who hates the whole affair all have a place under its tree.

Detectives.label: Detectives
Detectives.description: Snappy has read every whodunnit on the shelf and still guesses the culprit too late. Deerstalkers, rumpled raincoats, magnifying glasses and a talking dog with a snack habit are all on its list of suspects.

DevCulture.label: Dev Culture
DevCulture.description: Snappy has spent many nights perched next to developers. The mascots of their tools, their favourite memes and the rubber duck on the desk all rubbed off on it.

Easter.label: Easter
Easter.description: Snappy has joined every egg hunt it could find, mostly for the chocolate. Bunny ears, painted eggs and freshly hatched chicks fill its basket to the brim.

Fantasy.label: Fantasy
Fantasy.description: Snappy was read a fairy tale every night and always asked for one more. Wizards, dark lords, tea-party hatters, ogres from the swamp and the occasional dragon never quite left its imagination.

Fighters.label: Fighters
Fighters.description: Snappy lost a lot of pocket money in smoky arcades, button-mashing its way through tournament after tournament. Fireball throwers, masked ninjas and four-armed champions all made the cut.

FullMoon.label: Full Moon
FullMoon.description: Snappy is a night owl and has watched the full moon rise more often than it can count. Whatever howls, grins or shines under it has its full attention.

Gaming.label: Gaming
Gaming.description: Snappy has spent more nights with a controller than it would ever admit. Blue speed demons, pixel heroes, mighty pirates and crowbar-swinging physicists jumped from the screen into its wardrobe.

Halloween.label: Halloween
Halloween.description: Snappy has never missed a trick-or-treat night. Pumpkins, pointy hats and bedsheet ghosts are always the first things out of its costume box.

Horror.label: Horror
Horror.description: Snappy watched every late-night creature feature from behind its wing feathers. Masked slashers, stitched-together creatures, killer dolls and things from the dark still haunt its closet, only a lot friendlier now.

KidsTV.label: Kids' TV
KidsTV.description: Snappy learned its letters and numbers from the puppets on children's television. A blue fuzzball who lives for cookies, a grumpy loaf of bread and a talking orange mouse taught it far more than the alphabet.

Movies.label: Movies
Movies.description: Snappy has sat through countless film nights and series marathons, popcorn in its wings. Secret agents, ghost-catching exterminators, bathrobe-wearing slackers and everything else that stuck ended up here.

NewYear.label: New Year
NewYear.description: Snappy has seen in every new year with a glass of fizz and far too many party poppers. Tuxedos, lucky charms and the same procedure as every year are its idea of a proper party.

OffDuty.label: Off Duty
OffDuty.description: Even a master of disguise needs a day off. Between two costumes Snappy goes back to its roots: plain feathers, a warm cloak and the torch that started it all.

SaturdayMorning.label: Saturday Morning
SaturdayMorning.description: Snappy spent the 80s and 90s in front of weekend-morning cartoons, a cereal bowl on its lap. Colour-coded hero teams, sword-and-sorcery strongmen and masked heroes of the night were its best friends until lunchtime.

SciFi.label: Sci-Fi
SciFi.description: Snappy grew up on sci-fi double features and never quite recovered. Chosen ones in long black coats, cyborgs from the future, acid-blooded stowaways from deep space and tin-can robots still visit it in its dreams.

SpaceOpera.label: Space Opera
SpaceOpera.description: Snappy has picked a side in the great starship debate more than once and switched back every time. Laser swords, pointed ears and whole bridge crews share one wardrobe here.

Superheroes.label: Superheroes
Superheroes.description: Snappy read comic books under the blanket by torchlight, long after lights-out. Capes, masks, magic hammers and green giants with anger issues have filled its wardrobe ever since.

TimeTravel.label: Time Travel
TimeTravel.description: Snappy has always wanted to travel through time and watched every story that promised a way. Police boxes that are bigger on the inside, souped-up sports cars and very long scarves: it was only a matter of time.
